articles.title: Find in Quote: Show Values for matching quantities and prices
articles.body: Open the builder Tools menu > Find in Quote. Search item names, categories, descriptions, job notes or rooms; all search words must match. Turn on Show Values to display each result's actual Quantity and unit, Rate (before discounts) and Line total (before tax). Rate includes applicable markup and the active rate; line totals use the builder's discount and change-order calculations. Price TBD is labelled instead of shown as a zero price. Items excluded from the quote total are labelled Not included in quote total. The toggle starts off and is remembered only within the current page session, including closing and reopening Find in Quote. It does not edit or save quote data or affect client views. Results show stored quantities, not measurements extracted from descriptions. Search can match incidental mentions of drywall or other work: inspect each match before adding quantities and keep square feet, linear feet and other units separate. There is no automatic aggregate total. Toggle off to hide values; the search text and scroll position remain. Click a result title to close search and jump to that item.

articles.title: PDF formatting: smaller text and fewer printed pages
articles.body: Use Download / Print PDF in an opened quote, or File > Export as PDF in the builder and complete the Client or My records choice. Clean PDF Settings appears before the browser print window. Choose PDF text and layout size: Large (100%) is the default, Standard (85%) is smaller, or Compact (75%) is most compact. Continue to Print applies the selection; Cancel or X does not print or apply a new selection. The choice stays in the open viewer only and resets to Large on a fresh page. Scaling affects print output including internal appendices, not the interactive quote, saved quote content, prices or text completeness. It does not add private reports to client PDFs. Leave browser Scale at 100% to avoid shrinking twice; turn off Headers and footers and enable Background graphics. Choose Save as PDF or your printer. Check readability, page breaks and final page count in browser preview; no specific reduction is guaranteed because paper size, margins and browser rendering differ. If too small, cancel the browser dialog and choose Large through Download / Print PDF again. Browser Ctrl+P bypasses QDR's formatting dialog. Live editor previews cannot print: open the quote preview first. Keep normal quote backups; PDFs do not replace editable recovery files.

articles.title: Split Quote: move or copy basement rooms into a separate phase quote
articles.body: Save the original and wait for Cloud saved, then open Quote Actions > Split Quote / Related Quotes. Enter New quote name, check rooms/phases and choose Copy or Move. Copy is the default and leaves the original unchanged. Move is restricted to unshared drafts without payment or acceptance history and must leave at least one room. Invoices and change orders cannot be split here. Review the displayed new draft and original totals, then Review & Create Draft > Create Draft. These are scope values, not amounts owing. Room notes, photos, highlights and line pricing are copied; quote-wide adjustments stay on the original and are not apportioned to the new draft. The new quote has its own number and is unsent. No payments, signatures, invoices or portal access are transferred, and no client message is sent. Review its payment settings and expiry before sharing: expiry starts afresh, and deposit review does not carry over. The new draft must be cloud-saved and its rooms read back before Move updates the original. A full pre-split local recovery copy is retained; Download pre-split recovery copy is available in this dialog. Storage failure blocks the operation before either write. Original and split drafts are linked under Split Quote / Related Quotes; links open separately. If saving is unconfirmed, check Sync and Recovery and the dashboard before retrying: a queued draft may still sync. If the draft exists but reducing the original fails, do not split again or share either document until resolving the pending save/conflict. Keep the recovery copy and never overwrite a newer quote wholesale to recover selected rooms. Local recovery is not a guaranteed off-device backup; preserve your normal backups.

articles.title: Attach a quote-only line item photo without saving to the database
articles.body: In Add Line Item or Edit Line Item, find Item photo below Reusable Item Description. Choose Upload / Replace Photo and select a JPEG, PNG or WebP up to 10 MB. Review the thumbnail, then Add Line Item or Save Changes. No database item is required. Photos are resized to at most 1200 pixels and stored as JPEG; keep your original separately. Replace Photo replaces the item's photo collection with one picture. Remove Photo removes that collection on save. Cancel leaves the quote unchanged. Quote-only photo overrides, including removal, are preserved instead of refreshed from the library. Explicit Save To Database includes the edited photo in the reusable item; otherwise the library is unchanged. Wait for photo preparation before saving. A failed or unsupported upload leaves the previous picture unchanged: try another supported file. Wait for Cloud saved and verify after reopening; a thumbnail is not proof of cloud backup. Clients use the existing Picture control to view attached item photos. Keep your versioned backups and do not clear browser storage to troubleshoot a missing picture.

articles.title: Highlight description display: colour defaults and Apply to all
articles.body: Open Highlight Item and select a colour. Choose Show description on each item or Only show description in legend. With Customize for this item / selection unchecked, Apply Highlight saves the colour's default for this quote and updates matching items without custom exceptions. New highlights inherit this default. Tick Customize for this item / selection to make an exception without changing the colour default. Tick Apply to all with this colour, click Apply Highlight, then confirm Apply to All to update EVERY existing matching item across all rooms, including older highlights and custom exceptions, as well as the selected items. Other colours and other quotes are unchanged. Apply to all takes priority over Customize and establishes the default for future highlights. Cancel confirmation keeps the editor open without applying. Colour choices and Clear remain drafts until Apply Highlight. Shared wording is preserved unless explicitly cleared. Legacy quotes without a saved default infer legend-only if all matching items are legend-only, otherwise inline; use Apply to all to reconcile mixed older items. Save and wait for cloud confirmation before switching quotes. Defaults are included in local and cloud quote data; retain recovery backups and do not clear browser storage to resolve save problems.

articles.title: Guided description: AI follow-up questions from rough task notes
articles.body: AI Refine > tick Guided mode — Ask follow-up questions, then choose Describe the task to create the description. Enter rough notes and choose Create Description. Guided mode is off by default and requires signed-in AI Refine access and an internet connection. It asks up to four relevant questions at a time, each with an answer box and Skip ×; Skipped — Undo restores a skipped question. Answer or skip the current questions, then choose Ask follow-up questions for another round. Generate with what I have is always available, including with unanswered questions. The AI stops offering questions when it finds no useful missing details; it must not repeat answered or skipped topics. Skipped or blank answers remain unspecified, not promised work or exclusions. Review Preview description, then Use Description or Keep Original. Cancel or Close leaves the original unchanged; interview answers are temporary and are not a saved quote backup. Each question round and final generation uses AI usage, with guided limits of 40 requests hourly and 200 daily and a bounded input size. For a long interview, generate with the details collected rather than starting unlimited rounds. If questions fail or time out, answers remain in the open dialog; retry or generate. Check all AI wording for invented scope before applying. If the editor changes or closes meanwhile, the result cannot overwrite it. Applying a description does not itself save the line item or confirm cloud saving: finish Add Line Item or Save Changes and verify the save status. Ordinary Refine what I've written and non-guided creation remain available. Source and local tests are not proof of live AI answer quality.

articles.title: Highlight descriptions missing after switching quotes
articles.body: Highlight explanations belong to each quote, not the account. An earlier cloud-save omission could retain line-item colours while losing yellow or orange descriptions after opening another quote and returning. Cloud saves now include highlightLegend and the legacy changeOrderHighlightLegend field. Apply Highlight, wait for Cloud saved, then reopen to verify. The fix does not recreate already missing text. Keep local JSON and versioned folder backups; compare the same quote's older backup for the wording. Do not overwrite a newer quote wholesale just to restore a legend, and do not clear browser storage. Re-enter recovered wording in Highlight Item and Apply Highlight, then verify cloud saving. Intentional clearing remains supported; another quote's descriptions are never used as fallback. If wording disappears again, retain backups and report the quote and save status.

articles.title: Keyboard shortcuts: autofocus and Enter in quote dialogs
articles.body: Dashboard > New Quote focuses Client Name after the modal opens. Type the client name, then press Enter from a single-line field to activate Create & Open Builder; required-field validation and normal cloud saving still apply. Tab moves between fields. When client suggestions are open, choose a suggestion with Tab then Enter, or Tab to another field before submitting your typed name. Enter does not create a quote while suggestions are open or the Create button is disabled. Builder Add Room focuses Room Name; Enter adds the room. Add/Edit Line Item focuses Quick Search; Enter from a single-line field activates the editor's primary action, but not while search suggestions are visible. Select a saved item or move to another field first. Manage Clients focuses its filter; Save Quote focuses File Name without automatically choosing a save destination. Shared text prompts focus their input after opening. Notes keep Enter as a newline; dropdowns, buttons, composing text and held-down keys retain their normal behavior. Payment, sending, deletion and multi-action dialogs have no new blanket Enter confirmation. Wait for the displayed cloud-save confirmation before leaving; a keyboard shortcut is not evidence of a successful save.

articles.title: Ask me for each quote: request a deposit or no deposit
articles.body: In Settings > Payments > Deposit & Invoice Requests, enable Ask me for each quote and save payment settings. This overrides the Request a deposit after a client accepts a quote switch. Default deposit type and amount are suggestions, not a completed choice. In Builder near View Profit Report, select Choose / review deposit for this quote. Choose Request a deposit and a positive percentage up to 100% or a positive fixed amount, or choose No deposit, then Use for this quote. The choice is saved with the quote through the normal save flow; wait for cloud-save confirmation. If an unanswered draft is shared from Builder or Dashboard, the deposit dialog appears before publication or email; Cancel or Escape stops that action without applying a choice. Existing shared quotes retain their terms. Reopening or resending the same reviewed quote does not ask again; a duplicated Dashboard revision requires a fresh review. Saved Send Quote Settings defaults do not count as a review for a new quote. The Send Quote Settings Deposit Requirement override can also explicitly choose show or hide for the current quote. Deposits are separate from card-payment rules, require no Stripe connection for manual payment methods, and choosing a deposit does not charge or message a client. Fixed deposits are capped at the quote total. Invoice and Change Order workflows are unchanged. If review cannot load, retry after refreshing and verifying payment settings; do not treat a dialog choice as proof that cloud saving succeeded.

articles.title: PDF export for clients or internal records and profit reports
articles.body: PDF export for either Client or My records (internal) does not open Card Payment Review and does not answer or change the quote's existing card-payment choice. The normal interactive sharing workflow still requires its configured payment review. File > Export as PDF asks who the PDF is for. Client is selected every time and never includes the private appendix. Choose My records (internal) to label the document INTERNAL — NOT FOR CLIENT and add export timestamp, quote number and status. Optionally tick Include profit report, which requires profit_tracking access. Continue to PDF opens the authenticated contractor preview and the browser print dialog; choose Save as PDF. Internal title suggests an INTERNAL filename, but the browser controls the final filename. The appendix starts on a new page and uses the existing private report calculations: revenue less estimated materials, before labour and overhead, not net profit. It includes per-line costs and warns about zero material estimates. Tax, payments and quote-wide adjustments are not allocated to individual lines; change-order profit is unsupported. Internal report data stays temporarily in this browser tab and is not added to client share data or sent to the client. The handoff expires after five minutes and is consumed once; if missing or expired, start export again from the builder. Normal cloud saving and authenticated preview access must succeed before export; this is not an offline PDF workflow. A PDF is a record, not an editable recovery backup: retain JSON or folder backups. Review every PDF before sharing, and never send a copy marked INTERNAL to a client. Browser print rendering and live authenticated chatbot answers still require release verification.

articles.title: Quote expiry and send-time validity
articles.body: In Send Quote Settings > Quote Expiry, choose Days from first client sharing, Fixed expiry date, or No expiry. New quotes without existing preferences default to 30 days; existing quote dates and saved preferences are preserved. Choose 30, 60 or 90 days, or enter 1–365 days. Preset buttons ask whether to Save as Default or use This Quote Only. Use these settings for future quotes also saves defaults. Automatic validity starts when first published to the client portal, not while drafting or previewing; publication itself makes the quote available, even before emailing. Editing or resending does not renew an already-started deadline. Renew Expiry explicitly resets the duration for the next sharing; portal-locked quotes must first follow the normal remove-from-portal editing workflow. Expired or invalid dates block quote sharing and quote email; open settings and update the date. Fewer than seven calendar days remaining, including today, warns with Send Anyway or Go Back & Review. Exactly seven days does not warn. No expiry is allowed. Invoice and Change Order expiry are not changed by this quote check. The date displays as the selected calendar day, without UTC shifting it to the previous day. Wait for cloud-save confirmation; opening settings or saving defaults is not confirmation that a client-facing change was saved. Previously distributed links cannot be recalled by a send blocker.

articles.title: Quote Builder basics
articles.body:
- Start or open a quote, fill client information, then build the quote by room or area.
- Add Room creates a room/area section. Add Item inside a room opens Add Line Item.
- Add Line Item can use Quick Search to find saved items. Users can also create a new unsaved line item, save it to the database, or add it only to the current quote.
- Line items include category, item/service name, description, quantity, unit type, rate, optional material cost, supplier URL, and optional upgrade information.
- Rooms support scope notes, photos, timeline estimate, markup, undo, room templates, saved groups, and grouping controls.

articles.title: Bulk editing and highlight colours
articles.body:
- To highlight several line items, tick their checkboxes within a room, then use that room's Edit > Highlight Selected... Choose a colour and Apply Highlight. Edit > Select All Items selects that room's items, not every room in the quote.
- The same Edit menu supports Move Selected to..., Copy Selected to..., Duplicate Selected Here, Markup Selected and Delete Selected. Do not confuse bulk selection with saved Choice Groups.
- A single row's highlighter opens Highlight Item. Clicking the selected colour again or Clear deselects the draft colour without closing the window. Apply Highlight commits changes; closing with unsaved changes prompts before discarding.
- Each colour may have an optional explanation and a choice to show it on each item or only in the legend. Enter an explanation for the legend; AI Refine can polish it. Highlight colour alone is not a description.
- Client quotes retain the on-page legend and can show a dismissible legend introduction. Contractor preview may suppress the introduction.
- Colour explanations are retained even when no items use the colour. Clearing a highlight does not delete its explanation. To remove shared wording, empty its explanation and Apply Highlight, then confirm Clear Explanation. Keep Explanation restores the wording and leaves the editor open. Unused colours are omitted from the client legend.

articles.title: Saving, backups and recovery: Export All Quotes, unsaved edits and photos
articles.body:
- Cloud saved and folder backup verified are separate statuses. Saved on this device or syncing is NOT confirmation of a cloud save. Do not promise a draft is in the dashboard until cloud saving succeeds.
- Connect Backup Folder lets a supported browser save versioned quote files into a user-chosen folder while QuoteDr is open. Back Up Now requests a backup. The browser must grant folder access; this is not an always-running desktop backup service.
- Folder backups are organized beneath QuoteDr Backups by account, client and quote. Unchanged snapshots are deduplicated, earlier changed versions are retained. Files are not encrypted and do not include all uploaded media.
- Changing folders replaces the connection after confirmation; Disconnect forgets the connection without deleting existing files. A remembered connection is not a verified write. If an error occurs, retain existing files and report the exact error; do not assume Google Drive is the cause or that a file's existence proves verification.
- Dashboard Export All Quotes creates a portable backup of cloud quote records. It is not a backup of unsynced browser edits, every invoice or all media. Save a local copy of unsynced work separately.
- Open a local recovery file with File > Open > Open Local File, review the recovered content, then explicitly Save to the intended cloud destination. Opening a recovery is not itself a cloud save.
- If cloud saving fails or conflicts, keep the local recovery copy, check the displayed error and contact support if needed. Do not instruct users to repeatedly overwrite or clear storage.

articles.title: Old quote import and AI Refine writing assistance for notes
articles.body:
- Tools > Import Old Quote accepts supported PDF, image, spreadsheet and text sources. Parse Quote, review rooms, descriptions, quantities, rates and totals, then Apply to Quote. It can replace the quote or append rooms.
- Missing-unit labels can be chosen in the importer. Review warnings and the review acknowledgement can block Apply until checked. Save Selected Items saves selected reusable items to the library; Apply to Quote is a separate action.
- Undo Import requests confirmation before restoring the pre-import quote. Do not promise it remains available after refresh or that later edits will be preserved.
- AI Refine is available for reusable descriptions, job-specific notes and highlight explanations. It improves wording; the user should verify scope and facts before applying.
- Job-specific notes belong to the current job; reusable descriptions belong to the item template. Do not advise saving job-specific details into the reusable database.

articles.title: Manage Items and saved pricing
articles.body:
- Manage Items is the saved pricing database. It stores categories, item names, unit types, rates, material costs, supplier URLs, descriptions, photos, and upgrade options.
- Users can add a new category from the category picker, add new items, edit rows, filter/search, expand details, and Save Changed or Save All.
- Manage Items > Add Category saves a named empty category without creating a dummy line item. It becomes available in the category picker. Add Item still requires an actual item name and unit.
- Material Cost is the user's cost for margin tracking. Rate is what the client is charged.
- Upgrade options can have their own unit, rate, material cost, supplier URL, description, and photo.

articles.title: Saved Choice Groups
articles.body:
- Manage Items > Choice Group is where users view, create, edit, rename, and delete reusable saved choice groups.
- To create a saved group, open Manage Items, click Choice Group, click New, search/select saved items from the user's item database, choose Pick One or Pick Multiple, choose the default/base option for Pick One, keep "Always use grouping when any of these items are added to a quote" on if desired, then save.
- Pick One means the client chooses one option from several choices, such as vinyl flooring, laminate flooring, or hardwood flooring.
- Pick Multiple means the client can choose more than one option, such as baseboards, shoe moulding, and crown moulding.
- Saved Choice Groups can be manually added to a room with Saved Group.
- When auto-grouping is enabled, adding a saved item that belongs to a saved Choice Group can automatically place the whole group on the quote instead of a single normal line item.
- Auto-grouping applies to manual Add Line Item and AI Voice To Quote when saved groups are found.
- The quote may ask "Grouped items found. Use saved groups?" with Yes, No, and Review for AI Voice results.
- In Review, users can uncheck grouped suggestions before they hit the quote.
- Turn Off Grouping affects only that quote row. It asks which grouped option should remain and converts that row back into a normal line item.
- Disable Grouping on a room turns off automatic saved grouping for that room and makes grouping disabled by default for future new rooms until re-enabled.
- For Pick One rows, the Pick One badge in the quote builder opens a picker so the user can choose which option is the selected/base visible item. That selected option moves to the top for the client view but does not change the saved group template.

articles.title: AI Voice To Quote
articles.body:
- AI Voice To Quote lets the user record a spoken scope, pause/resume recording, generate parsed items, and review before adding to the quote.
- AI Voice Review lists parsed items, puts uncertain or duplicate items at the top, lets users include/exclude rows, match typed phrases to saved items, add notes, save learned mappings, and keep or hide AI-generated room scope notes.
- For paint walls, QuoteDr should use perimeter times wall height when room dimensions and ceiling height are known.
- If ceiling height or another required measurement is missing for a relevant calculation, the review step should ask for it before finalizing.
- AI Memory stores user-specific phrase-to-item mappings learned from voice corrections.
- AI Trade Rules let users teach rules like "when I say case a door, apply 35 linear feet of 2-3/4 MDF trim per door."
- Voice Templates let users save reusable packages such as "standard bedroom package" and apply quantities from room dimensions.
- AI Voice can use saved Choice Groups through the same grouping helper as normal quote additions.

articles.title: Sending quotes, client choices, and approvals
articles.body:
- Send Quote Settings controls quote style, pricing detail, deposit display, approval type, expiry, and client message.
- Client views can show itemized pricing, category subtotals, or total-only depending on pricing detail.
- Approval Type can allow accept quote, accept/request changes, or review-only.
- Client-facing choice groups show Pick One or Pick Multiple options. The client can select options in the interactive quote view.
- Client notes/requested changes should be reviewed before updating a quote.

articles.title: Invoices and payments
articles.body:
- Quotes can be converted or sent as invoices from the invoice tools.
- Stripe Payments are configured in Settings > Payments.
- Settings > Payments can enable Stripe, set the default deposit percent, show a deposit payment button on quote links, and show a pay-in-full button on invoice links.
- Deposit payment button on quote links is for collecting deposits from accepted or shared quote links when enabled.
- Pay-in-full button on invoice links is for collecting full invoice balances when enabled.
- Manual payment instructions can also be shown for e-transfer, cash, cheque, or other offline payment methods.

articles.title: Dashboard, settings, and feedback
articles.body:
- Dashboard is where users create, open, manage, and track saved quotes.
- Settings includes Business Profile, Quote Preferences, Manage Items entry point, AI Voice Learning, email/reminder settings, Feedback, Payments, QuickBooks, and Account/Plan controls.
- Feedback is the correct place for bugs and feature ideas. Direct users to Settings > Feedback when QuoteDr does not have a requested feature yet.
- Basic includes core quoting, invoicing, clients, branding, sync, templates, and Stripe payments. Pro unlocks AI voice quote tools, AI assistant, smart import, floor plan scanner, QuickBooks, upsells, profit tracking, and reminders where available.

articles.title: Job note preview length
articles.body: In Send Quote Settings, use Job note preview length to choose how much of each job-specific note is initially visible in the client quote. Set the slider to 0 for full text, or choose 20–1200 characters before Show more. The client can expand the full note; this does not hide confidential content or delete any text. The setting is independent of description and scope preview lengths. The live preview updates and Save Defaults can retain the preference. Existing quotes without this setting keep full notes.
